const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboCasa365 CookieDoughPrep controller record.
+
+This controller uses only service RGB/depth, camera calibrations, and robot
+proprioception.  The interactive helpers below are used to execute small,
+visually checked movements during the live episode.
+"""
+import json
+import time
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+DT = float(spec["control_dt"])
+EYE = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
+CAMERAS = list(spec["cameras"])
+LAYOUT = spec["proprio_layout"]
+IDX = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(LAYOUT)}
+
+def obs(cameras=(EYE,), depth=False):
+    return r.get_obs(cameras=list(cameras), include_depth=depth, video="none")
+
+def state(o=None):
+    o = obs(()) if o is None else o
+    p = o.meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    return np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
+
+def current_q(p=None):
+    p = state() if p is None else p
+    return np.array([p[IDX[f"cmd_arm_joint{i}"] if f"cmd_arm_joint{i}" in IDX else IDX[f"cmd_arm_joint{i+1}"]] for i in range(1, 8)])
+
+def measured_q(p=None):
+    p = state() if p is None else p
+    return np.array([p[IDX[f"robot0_joint{i}_pos"]] for i in range(1, 8)])
+
+def eef_xyz(p=None):
+    p = state() if p is None else p
+    return np.array([p[IDX[k]] for k in ("eef_right_x", "eef_right_y", "eef_right_z")])
+
+def command(q=None, grip=None, base=(0., 0., 0.), torso=0., mode=-1., seconds=.5,
+            cameras=(EYE,), video="none", note=""):
+    """Hold one native target for `seconds`; return the last observation."""
+    p = state()
+    q0 = current_q(p)
+    if q is None:
+        q = q0
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float).reshape(7)
+    g = p[IDX["cmd_grip"]] if grip is None else float(grip)
+    prev = [p[IDX["cmd_base_x"]], p[IDX["cmd_base_y"]], p[IDX["cmd_base_yaw"]]]
+    tv = p[IDX["cmd_torso"]] if torso is None else float(torso)
+    hm = p[IDX["cmd_hybrid_mode"]] if mode is None else float(mode)
+    row = np.r_[q, g, np.asarray(base, float), tv, hm]
+    n = max(1, int(round(float(seconds) / DT)))
+    res = r.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(row[None, :], n, axis=0),
+                   interpolate="hold", cameras=list(cameras), video="none", note=note)
+    return res
+
+def save_obs(o, tag):
+    for cam, im in o.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/{tag}_{cam}.png")
+    for cam, d in o.depth.items():
+        np.save(f"/app/output/{tag}_depth_{cam}.npy", d)
+
+def move_q(q, seconds=1.0, note="arm move"):
+    return command(q=q, seconds=seconds, note=note)
+
+def finite_difference_jacobian(eps=.012, settle=.35):
+    """Position Jacobian measured from eef proprio, with small reversible probes."""
+    p0 = state()
+    q0 = current_q(p0)
+    x0 = eef_xyz(p0)
+    J = np.zeros((3, 7))
+    for j in range(7):
+        q = q0.copy(); q[j] += eps
+        command(q=q, seconds=settle, note=f"small Jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
+        p1 = state(); x1 = eef_xyz(p1)
+        J[:, j] = (x1 - x0) / eps
+        command(q=q0, seconds=settle, note=f"restore Jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
+    return J
+
+def cartesian_step(target, J=None, gain=.6, max_joint=.10, seconds=.6):
+    """One damped least-squares visual-servo step toward a world xyz target."""
+    p = state()
+    q = current_q(p)
+    x = eef_xyz(p)
+    if J is None:
+        J = finite_difference_jacobian()
+    err = np.asarray(target, float) - x
+    dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + (0.025 ** 2) * np.eye(3), gain * err)
+    m = np.max(np.abs(dq))
+    if m > max_joint:
+        dq *= max_joint / m
+    command(q=q + dq, seconds=seconds, note="Cartesian visual servo")
+    return {"xyz": eef_xyz(), "error": err, "dq": dq}
+
+print("connected", json.dumps({"dt": DT, "cameras": CAMERAS, "proprio": list(zip(LAYOUT, state().tolist()))}, indent=1))
*** End Patch";

+def so3_log(R):
+    """Rotation vector for a 3x3 rotation matrix."""
+    tr = float(np.clip((np.trace(R) - 1.0) * .5, -1.0, 1.0))
+    angle = float(np.arccos(tr))
+    vee = np.array([R[2, 1] - R[1, 2], R[0, 2] - R[2, 0], R[1, 0] - R[0, 1]]) * .5
+    if angle < 1e-6:
+        return vee
+    s = np.sin(angle)
+    if abs(s) < 1e-6:
+        return angle * vee / max(np.linalg.norm(vee), 1e-9)
+    return (angle / s) * vee
+
+def camera_pose(o):
+    T = np.asarray(o.meta["cameras"][EYE]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
+    return T[:3, 3], T[:3, :3]
+
+def finite_pose_jacobian(eps=.012, settle=.35):
+    """Measure a six dimensional wrist-camera pose Jacobian by reversible probes."""
+    o0 = obs()
+    p0 = np.asarray(o0.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    q0 = current_q(p0)
+    x0 = eef_xyz(p0)
+    _, R0 = camera_pose(o0)
+    J = np.zeros((6, 7))
+    for j in range(7):
+        q = q0.copy(); q[j] += eps
+        o1 = command(q=q, seconds=settle, note=f"small pose Jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
+        p1 = np.asarray(o1.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+        _, R1 = camera_pose(o1)
+        J[:3, j] = (eef_xyz(p1) - x0) / eps
+        J[3:, j] = so3_log(R1 @ R0.T) / eps
+        command(q=q0, seconds=settle, note=f"restore pose Jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
+    return J
+
+def pose_servo_step(target_xyz, target_R, J=None, gain=.45, max_joint=.08, seconds=.5):
+    """Move a short distance in xyz while holding the wrist camera orientation."""
+    o = obs()
+    p = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    q = current_q(p)
+    x = eef_xyz(p)
+    _, R = camera_pose(o)
+    if J is None:
+        J = finite_pose_jacobian()
+    err = np.r_[np.asarray(target_xyz, float) - x, so3_log(np.asarray(target_R) @ R.T)]
+    # Position is metrically scaled; wrist rotation is slightly downweighted.
+    W = np.diag([1., 1., 1., .20, .20, .20])
+    A = W @ J
+    b = W @ (gain * err)
+    dq = A.T @ np.linalg.solve(A @ A.T + (.035 ** 2) * np.eye(6), b)
+    m = np.max(np.abs(dq))
+    if m > max_joint:
+        dq *= max_joint / m
+    res = command(q=q + dq, seconds=seconds, note="Cartesian pose visual servo")
+    p1 = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    _, R1 = camera_pose(res)
+    return {"xyz": eef_xyz(p1), "rotation_error": so3_log(np.asarray(target_R) @ R1.T), "position_error": np.asarray(target_xyz)-eef_xyz(p1), "dq": dq}
